lines.text: Are we still having lunch together on Wednesday?
lines.speaker: Hui

lines.text: I'm going to meet a new client at noon.
lines.speaker: Mia

lines.text: Could we have lunch a little later, around one?
lines.speaker: Hui

lines.text: I'd love to, but I have a call at one.
lines.speaker: Mia

lines.text: How about Thursday at twelve thirty, then?
lines.speaker: Hui

lines.text: Thursday works for me. Can we eat near the office?
lines.speaker: Mia

lines.text: Sure. Let's meet at the noodle shop across the street.
lines.speaker: Hui

lines.text: Great. Thursday at twelve thirty at the noodle shop.
lines.speaker: Mia
